scripts.build: bun run build:core && bun run build:commonmark && bun run build:trap-extension && bun run build:traq && bun run build:corpus
scripts.check: bun run format:check && bun run lint:check && bun run build && bun run typecheck && bun run test && bun run lint:rust && bun run verify
scripts.check:generated: bun run generate:bindings && bun run scripts/check-generated.ts
scripts.format: bun run format:prettier && bun run format:rust && bun run format:go
scripts.format:check: bun run format:prettier:check && bun run format:rust:check && bun run format:go:check
scripts.test: bun run test:typescript && bun run test:corpus && bun run test:rust && bun run test:go
scripts.test:go: go -C packages/core/go test -count=1 ./... && go -C packages/commonmark/go test -count=1 ./... && go -C packages/trap-extension/go test -count=1 ./... && go -C packages/traq/go test -count=1 ./... && go -C packages/traq/examples/go test -count=1 ./...
scripts.test:typescript: bun run --cwd packages/core test && bun run --cwd packages/traq test
scripts.typecheck: node ./node_modules/@typescript/native/bin/tsc -p tsconfig.json && bun run typecheck:core && bun run typecheck:commonmark && bun run typecheck:trap-extension && bun run typecheck:traq
scripts.verify: bun run check:architecture && bun run check:package && bun run check:generated
